name: Halide Scheduling for Gradient Kernels
definition: A heuristic-based scheduling strategy for reverse-mode AD gradient programs on GPUs, splitting the program into multiple smaller kernels to utilize available registers while minimizing memory I/O, avoiding register spilling.
summary: Halide Scheduling for Gradient Kernels optimizes GPU reverse-mode automatic differentiation by splitting gradient computation into smaller kernels to explicitly manage register pressure and memory I/O overhead.
